name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task 'Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off' is a 'whenever' rule, and Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) hard captures it exactly: each ringing period charges the promise, and the toggle that silences the siren closes it, as the machine shows (charge on siren_ringing&!switch_toggled into u1, +1 on switch_toggled back to u0). The siren condition is the condition of an 'each time' sentence, so it correctly gets no Existence, and the rule-only warning is valid since the task imposes only a restriction and nothing is commanded unconditionally. Toggling while the siren is silent stays unrewarded, matching the environment where such a toggle does nothing, and each later ring opens a fresh promise, matching 'each time'.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
